Well sure, but this is just the nature of the beast in terms of game programming. Console games (up until now) are programmed to have just a single set of display parameters, because in theory there's only a single hardware spec on which to run. If a hardware variable is introduced, then a second set of display parameters would need to be patched in. If a PC game only came with a single display setting, improving your hardware wouldn't change the visuals. Minesweeper looks the same regardless of what you're running it on. The original StarCraft ain't getting any better than 640x480 with zero AA whether you're running it on a P3 with 256MB RAM and integrated graphics or an i7/16GB/GTX 1080. If your PC can run Witcher 3 at 4k (or whatever the max res is) and everything cranked to Ultra settings, the PC you have 10 years in the future won't make it look any better unless they patch in some Super-Ultra settings.
